original.target_description: Verified matching Staniland and Byrne (2013) full-text accepted manuscript. Study examines adolescent boys, three conditions, three time points, and knowledge (AKQ), attitudes (ACL), and behavioural intentions (SAQ). Supplied locator p. 8 and the description do not specify a unique outcome, comparison, time contrast, or test. The manuscript has pagination different from the published article. Multiple main effects, interactions, and follow-up tests are reported; no single test selected.

replication.target_description: Ranson and Byrne (2014): bibliographic title matched at publisher and OpenAlex, but verified full text unavailable through attempted public routes.

notes: Blind extraction. No effect assignment inferred from input order. Original full text was acquired from the University of Wollongong institutional repository via Figshare and its title verified. Original is available; unresolved issue is test identification, not paper availability. Generic recruited sample was not treated as analytic n. Replication acquisition failure recorded in texts/aa4d2598f34ea5adf20855eb.miss. Authors' narrative replication verdict not extracted from abstract-only access.
